events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: It's 35 years since the legendary Queen frontman, Freddie Mercury, passed away.

angles.name: Freddie Tribute
angles.copy: 35 years. The voice, the showmanship, the legend. Today we remember Freddie Mercury, a true icon of rock.

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' Turns 61
events.blurb: The Beatles released their groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul' 61 years ago today.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Anniversary
angles.copy: 61 years since The Beatles dropped 'Rubber Soul'. A pivotal moment in music history, still sounding fresh today.

events.title: Remembering John Lennon
events.blurb: We remember John Lennon, who tragically passed away 46 years ago.

angles.name: John Lennon Tribute
angles.copy: 46 years on, John Lennon's music and message continue to resonate. A true visionary, never forgotten.

events.title: David Bowie would have been 80
events.blurb: The legendary David Bowie would have celebrated his 80th birthday today.

angles.name: Bowie 80th
angles.copy: The Starman would have been 80 today. Celebrating the incredible legacy of David Bowie, a true innovator.

events.title: Elvis Presley would have been 92
events.blurb: The King of Rock 'n' Roll, Elvis Presley, would have turned 92 today.

angles.name: Elvis 92nd
angles.copy: Long live the King! Elvis Presley would have been 92 today. Still shaking up the airwaves.

events.title: Jimmy Page turns 83
events.blurb: Led Zeppelin guitarist and rock icon, Jimmy Page, celebrates his 83rd birthday today.

angles.name: Jimmy Page Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 83rd to the legendary Jimmy Page. The man who gave us some of the greatest riffs in rock history. Turn it up!

events.title: Rod Stewart turns 82
events.blurb: Sir Rod Stewart, the iconic British singer with the distinctive raspy voice, celebrates his 82nd birthday.

angles.name: Rod Stewart Birthday
angles.copy: Still sailing with that signature voice! Happy 82nd birthday to the one and only Rod Stewart.

events.title: Suggs turns 66
events.blurb: Graham McPherson, better known as Suggs, the charismatic frontman of Madness, celebrates his 66th birthday.

angles.name: Suggs Birthday
angles.copy: One Step Beyond for Suggs, who turns 66 today! Here's to the Nutty Boy still bringing the House of Fun.

events.title: Paul Young turns 71
events.blurb: British blue-eyed soul singer Paul Young, known for hits like 'Wherever I Lay My Hat', celebrates his 71st birthday.

angles.name: Paul Young Birthday
angles.copy: Wherever he lays his hat, that's his home. Happy 71st birthday to the smooth voice of Paul Young!

events.title: Dolly Parton turns 81
events.blurb: The legendary Queen of Country music, Dolly Parton, celebrates her 81st birthday.

angles.name: Dolly Parton Birthday
angles.copy: From humble beginnings to an absolute icon. Happy 81st birthday to the one and only Dolly Parton!

events.title: Gary Barlow turns 56
events.blurb: Take That frontman and renowned songwriter, Gary Barlow, celebrates his 56th birthday today.

angles.name: Gary Barlow Birthday
angles.copy: He's still got that magic! Wishing a very happy 56th birthday to Take That's Gary Barlow.

events.title: Billy Ocean turns 77
events.blurb: Trinidadian-British singer-songwriter Billy Ocean, famous for his 80s hits, celebrates his 77th birthday.

angles.name: Billy Ocean Birthday
angles.copy: Get outta his dreams, get into his car... and wish Billy Ocean a very happy 77th birthday!

events.title: Rock & Roll Hall of Fame's 41st Anniversary
events.blurb: It's 41 years since the first Rock & Roll Hall of Fame induction ceremony, which took place on January 23, 1986.

angles.name: Rock Hall Anniversary
angles.copy: 41 years since rock's greatest legends got their official nod. Who would you induct into the Rock & Roll Hall of Fame today?

events.title: Mark Owen turns 55
events.blurb: Take That member Mark Owen, known for his solo work and band hits, celebrates his 55th birthday.

angles.name: Mark Owen Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 55th birthday to Take That's Mark Owen! Still got that boyband charm.

events.title: Beatles Rooftop Concert: 58 Years On
events.blurb: The Beatles performed their legendary final public concert on the rooftop of Apple Corps headquarters 58 years ago today.

angles.name: Beatles Rooftop
angles.copy: 58 years ago, The Beatles played their last ever live gig on a London rooftop. What a way to go out!

events.title: Phil Collins turns 76
events.blurb: Genesis drummer and hugely successful solo artist, Phil Collins, celebrates his 76th birthday.

angles.name: Phil Collins Birthday
angles.copy: In the air tonight, there's a birthday celebration! Happy 76th to the legendary Phil Collins.

events.title: Hugh Grant turns 67
events.blurb: Beloved British actor Hugh Grant, known for his charming roles in romantic comedies, celebrates his 67th birthday.

angles.name: Hugh Grant Birthday
angles.copy: Still charming us on screen! Happy 67th birthday to the quintessential British leading man, Hugh Grant.

events.title: Justin Timberlake turns 46
events.blurb: Pop superstar, actor, and former NSYNC member Justin Timberlake celebrates his 46th birthday.

angles.name: Justin Timberlake Birthday
angles.copy: He's bringing sexy back, and another year older! Happy 46th birthday to the one and only Justin Timberlake.

events.title: David Jason turns 87
events.blurb: Sir David Jason, the iconic British actor known for 'Only Fools and Horses' and 'A Touch of Frost', celebrates his 87th birthday.

angles.name: David Jason Birthday
angles.copy: Lovely jubbly! Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the national treasure, Sir David Jason.

events.title: The Day The Music Died: 68 Years On
events.blurb: It's 68 years since the tragic plane crash that claimed the lives of Buddy Holly, Ritchie Valens, and The Big Bopper.

angles.name: Day Music Died
angles.copy: 68 years since we lost three legends too soon. Remembering Buddy Holly, Ritchie Valens, and The Big Bopper on 'The Day The Music Died'.

events.title: Rick Astley turns 61
events.blurb: British pop icon Rick Astley, famous for never giving us up, celebrates his 61st birthday.

angles.name: Rick Astley Birthday
angles.copy: He's never gonna give you up, and we're never gonna forget his 61st birthday! Happy birthday, Rick Astley.

events.title: Bob Marley would have been 82
events.blurb: The legendary reggae pioneer Bob Marley would have celebrated his 82nd birthday today.

angles.name: Bob Marley Birthday
angles.copy: One love, one heart, one legend. Bob Marley would have been 82 today. Still inspiring generations.

events.title: Carole King turns 85
events.blurb: Grammy-winning singer-songwriter Carole King, whose 'Tapestry' album is a classic, celebrates her 85th birthday.

angles.name: Carole King Birthday
angles.copy: Still weaving magic with her melodies! Happy 85th birthday to the iconic songwriter, Carole King.

events.title: Remembering Whitney Houston
events.blurb: We remember the incredible voice of Whitney Houston, who passed away 15 years ago today.

angles.name: Whitney Tribute
angles.copy: 15 years since we lost 'The Voice'. Today, we celebrate the unforgettable legacy of Whitney Houston.

events.title: Take That Split: 31 Years Ago
events.blurb: It's 31 years since Take That announced their split, devastating fans across the nation.

angles.name: Take That Split Anniversary
angles.copy: Remember where you were when Take That said 'It's all over'? 31 years on, the memories (and the helpline numbers) live on!

events.title: Ali Campbell turns 68
events.blurb: Ali Campbell, the distinctive voice of reggae band UB40, celebrates his 68th birthday.

angles.name: Ali Campbell Birthday
angles.copy: Red, Red Wine and 68 years of incredible music! Happy birthday to UB40's Ali Campbell.

events.title: Ed Sheeran turns 36
events.blurb: Global superstar Ed Sheeran, known for his chart-topping hits and acoustic style, celebrates his 36th birthday.

angles.name: Ed Sheeran Birthday
angles.copy: From Framlingham to stadiums worldwide! Happy 36th birthday to the one and only Ed Sheeran.

events.title: George Harrison would have been 84
events.blurb: The quiet Beatle, George Harrison, would have celebrated his 84th birthday today.

angles.name: George Harrison Birthday
angles.copy: Here Comes The Sun, and a birthday tribute! George Harrison would have been 84 today. Forever in our thoughts.

events.title: Roger Daltrey turns 83
events.blurb: The iconic frontman of The Who, Roger Daltrey, celebrates his 83rd birthday.

angles.name: Roger Daltrey Birthday
angles.copy: Hope he gets what he wants! Happy 83rd birthday to the legendary voice of The Who, Roger Daltrey.

events.title: Nik Kershaw turns 69
events.blurb: British singer-songwriter Nik Kershaw, known for his 80s synth-pop hits, celebrates his 69th birthday.

angles.name: Nik Kershaw Birthday
angles.copy: Wouldn't it be good to wish Nik Kershaw a happy 69th birthday? We certainly think so!

events.title: Chris Martin turns 50
events.blurb: Coldplay frontman and global music star Chris Martin celebrates his 50th birthday.

angles.name: Chris Martin Birthday
angles.copy: It was all yellow... and now it's 50! Happy birthday to Coldplay's incredible frontman, Chris Martin.

events.title: Jon Bon Jovi turns 65
events.blurb: Rock legend and Bon Jovi frontman, Jon Bon Jovi, celebrates his 65th birthday.

angles.name: Jon Bon Jovi Birthday
angles.copy: Livin' on a prayer and turning 65! Happy birthday to the rock icon, Jon Bon Jovi.

events.title: Chris Rea would have been 76
events.blurb: We remember the gravel-voiced blues-rock singer Chris Rea, who would have celebrated his 76th birthday today.

angles.name: Chris Rea Birthday
angles.copy: Driving Home For Christmas, and a birthday tribute. Chris Rea would have been 76 today.
